lines: Transfer From Other Funds; County Cash
evidence: Money moved in from another County fund, mostly the General Fund's County match. The audited reports count it as a transfer, not revenue.
Indirect costs charged to other County funds and agencies (the book's "Charges to County Agencies").
Paid from the County's Human Services Development Fund to another County fund ("Charges to County Agencies").
The County's own share of youth detention costs, charged between County funds ("Charges to County Agencies").
